study: Phase 3 V10.9 empirical distributional overlap audit
inputs: Archived outcome-blind V6 pairs and independently rebuilt frozen eligible pre-event covariates
reference: Full eligible separation and retest classes within definition x asset x direction, before matching
diagnostics: two-sample empirical KS distance (statistic only; no inferential p-values)
1D Wasserstein distance normalized by pooled class SD
median difference normalized by pooled class SD
fraction of matched endpoints inside shared central range
limitations: univariate diagnostics do not establish multivariate common support
KS statistic is not used as an inferential hypothesis test
matched endpoints are selected observations; support diagnostics are descriptive
broad and strict cohorts are nested
no outcomes are loaded or compared; no trading inference is made
acceptance_status: No cohort accepted for outcome comparison
